name: Plan Code Runner
description: Runs or resumes implementation plans through the coder agent. Persisted checkpoints recover completed steps, interrupted coder calls, and pending deviation revisions.

commands.title: Run implementation plan
commands.description: Starts or resumes a plan. Input: {"planPath":"absolute plan JSON path", optional agent names/limits/timeouts, "startNew":false}. Saves checkpoints in <planPath>.run-state.json after every step and before risky transitions. Use resume_plan after stops/errors; unfinished work cannot restart accidentally. startNew:true archives prior state for an intentional restart.

commands.title: Resume implementation plan
commands.description: Resumes a paused run from <planPath>.run-state.json. Completed coder steps are skipped. An interrupted coder step is cautiously rechecked; a pending deviation revision resumes by invoking the reviser, without invoking the coder again for that already-reported step.

commands.title: Preview plan steps
commands.description: Reads and validates a plan JSON file without executing agents, and reports whether a saved run checkpoint is available. Input: {"planPath":"absolute plan JSON path"} or a plain path string.
